cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework and in this video I'm going to show you how to do a tool search.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片，要示範工具搜尋。

cues.en: Tool search is something from OpenAI.
cues.zh: Tool Search 是 OpenAI 提供的功能。

cues.en: And when I began researching this, I thought it was, yeah, okay, we are going to do this, this, and this, and then we're done.
cues.zh: 剛開始研究時，我以為只要做幾個設定就完成了。

cues.en: So an easy small video, but the rabbit hole is actually quite deep in this feature.
cues.zh: 原本以為是很短的小主題，結果發現裡面其實相當深入。

cues.en: But let's get into it to better understand.
cues.zh: 我們來了解一下。

cues.en: So I have four different scenarios of using tools, and this is all about saving tokens when it comes to tools.
cues.zh: 這裡有四種工具使用情境，重點都是減少工具造成的 Token 消耗。

cues.en: So let's jump into it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: So in my samples repo, I have under tools calling an MCP sample here called tool search.
cues.zh: 範例儲存庫的 Tool Calling 與 MCP 底下，有 Tool Search 範例。

cues.en: I'm using Azure here, but it works both for Azure and OpenAI, so it's still an OpenAI standard.
cues.zh: 我這裡使用 Azure，不過 Azure 與 OpenAI 都支援，仍然是 OpenAI 的功能。

cues.en: And I have built in that I can use different tool strategies here, but we are starting out without this search tool.
cues.zh: 範例可以選不同的工具策略，先從不使用搜尋工具開始。

cues.en: So just to see how we can do this.
cues.zh: 先看看原本的方式。

cues.en: And I'm using the GitHub MCP because it has a bunch of tools, because with just simple tools, this
cues.zh: 我使用 GitHub MCP，因為它的工具很多；如果只有簡單工具，

cues.en: is an overhead that is not worth doing.
cues.zh: 這種額外機制可能不划算。

cues.en: So you really need to begin to see your tool counts be in the numbers of like a couple of thousand
cues.zh: 通常工具定義本身至少需要幾千個，

cues.en: tokens just to have them as definitions before this begins to give value.
cues.zh: Token 時，才開始看得到價值。

cues.en: Lower than that, you don't really see anything.
cues.zh: 低於這個數量，差異通常不明顯。

cues.en: But let's run this and take it from there.
cues.zh: 先執行，再逐步說明。

cues.en: So I'm just going to switch to this as the start of projects and run it.
cues.zh: 把它設為啟始專案並啟動。

cues.en: So I'm going to track that over in one second, but we're just going to make an Azure OpenAI client,
cues.zh: 稍後把視窗移過來；首先建立 AzureOpenAIClient，

cues.en: and we're going to make the MCP for GitHub.
cues.zh: 再建立 GitHub MCP 用戶端。

cues.en: And GitHub's MCP is known for having a lot of tools, 49, and those tools are very, very heavy,
cues.zh: GitHub MCP 以工具多聞名，這裡有四十九個，而且定義很重，

cues.en: meaning there's a lot of parameters in and out.
cues.zh: 代表輸入輸出參數與描述非常多。

cues.en: So it's a very heavy to use tool.
cues.zh: 所以工具定義會占用很多 Token。

cues.en: And given we are without the search tool, we're just doing normal things.
cues.zh: 目前沒有搜尋工具，因此使用一般做法。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do here is I'm just going to take those tools and make an agent.
cues.zh: 直接取出所有工具，建立代理程式。

cues.en: So we're just making a normal response client agent, and we need to use responses API because that's the only one that support these tool searches.
cues.zh: 這是一般 Responses Client Agent；必須使用 Responses API，因為只有它支援這種工具搜尋。

cues.en: And also it's only newer models, meaning Chattopaddy 5.5 or something like that.
cues.zh: 而且需要較新的模型，例如 GPT-5.5 左右的版本。

cues.en: It might be a bit further back as well.
cues.zh: 也可能更早一些就有支援。

cues.en: But we're just going to make a GitHub expert, and we're just going to give all the 39 tools to Luna here.
cues.zh: 指示它扮演 GitHub 專家，再把全部工具交給 Luna。

cues.en: So nothing special there.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有特別之處。

cues.en: And then we are going to put on some middleware, make sessions, and then just ask the client.
cues.zh: 接著加入中介軟體、建立 session，再提出問題。

cues.en: There's some more stuff down here, but we will get to that.
cues.zh: 下方還有一些程式碼，稍後會介紹。

cues.en: And we're just going to write out how many tokens it cost.
cues.zh: 這裡只輸出使用了多少 Token。

cues.en: So if I run this and ask just hi, you will see that I'm using 9,451 tokens just when we say hi.
cues.zh: 如果只說你好，就會看到用了 9,451 個 Token。

cues.en: And that is because, of course, we have these 49 tools.
cues.zh: 原因當然就是那四十九個工具。

cues.en: They are very expensive, and AI still need all the tools in order to be able to perhaps need to call them.
cues.zh: 它們非常耗費 Token，模型必須先取得定義，才可能決定要不要呼叫。

cues.en: It didn't know when I said hi if it needed to call some of the tools.
cues.zh: 我們說你好之前，它並不知道是否需要使用工具。

cues.en: So this is very normal if you want to see the life of an LLM to know exactly what this is about.
cues.zh: 這是一般 LLM 呼叫的正常情況；如果想完整理解，

cues.en: It's a previous video of mine.
cues.zh: 可以看我之前介紹 LLM 呼叫生命週期的影片。

cues.en: But if we then begin to use some of the tools, I ask for something.
cues.zh: 接著開始使用工具，例如提出要求。

cues.en: So, for example, if I say Show Profile, we will, of course, use tokens for calling this Get Me tool,
cues.zh: 如果說「顯示個人檔案」，就會呼叫 GetMe，

cues.en: which is showing my GitHub profile.
cues.zh: 顯示我的 GitHub 個人資料。

cues.en: And we can see we are up to 20,000 tokens.
cues.zh: 可以看到總用量來到兩萬個 Token。

cues.en: This is mostly because of session, because we both used 9,000 in the first one, 9,000 in the second one, and then a little to call this specific tool.
cues.zh: 主要因為 session 累積用量：第一次九千、第二次九千，再加上一些工具呼叫。

cues.en: So let's roughly count it as 10,000 and 20,000 in order to say hi and Show Profile.
cues.zh: 所以粗略來看，打招呼與顯示個人檔案，分別累積到一萬與兩萬。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm going to try and use the Search tool.
cues.zh: 接著嘗試加入搜尋工具。

cues.en: And there's multiple ways of using the Search tool.
cues.zh: 搜尋工具有幾種使用方式。

cues.en: So let's go into seeing how we set it up.
cues.zh: 先看如何設定。

cues.en: So this is the same as before, but we're going to go in here.
cues.zh: 這裡和剛才一樣，不過改進入這個分支。

cues.en: And in this case, the only thing that is different is that on top of the 49 Search tools,
cues.zh: 唯一差別，是除了原本四十九個工具，

cues.en: we're also just giving this hosted tool Search tool. Nothing more.
cues.zh: 再多提供一個 HostedToolSearchTool，沒有其他變更。

cues.en: We're just giving one more tool.
cues.zh: 只多一個工具。

cues.en: And that should, of course, make it even worse.
cues.zh: 照理說應該更耗 Token。

cues.en: 9,400 was before, probably 9,500.
But let me run it, and let's see what happens when we say hi to it.
cues.zh: 但實際執行，看看只說你好會發生什麼。

cues.en: Now we are suddenly only spending 3,000 tokens to say hi.
cues.zh: 現在突然只用了三千個 Token。

cues.en: And if we say Show Profile, we call that one tool.
cues.zh: 再說「顯示個人檔案」，會呼叫那個工具。

cues.en: And we're seeing that we're spending 8,575.
cues.zh: 總用量是 8,575。

cues.en: So we are down to both calls now costing less than the first call with tools.
cues.zh: 因此兩次呼叫合計，甚至比原本第一次還少。

cues.en: So this is a kind of magical tool that we haven't really understood how it could do this, but apparently it could do exactly the same thing,
cues.zh: 這個工具看起來很神奇，不太知道為什麼做得到，但它確實完成相同工作，

cues.en: but without us needing to do anything more, just by giving one extra tool.
cues.zh: 而我們只多提供了一個工具，沒有做其他設定。

cues.en: And what it does is, if we pull down the system, because our middleware cannot show it
cues.zh: 若要看它實際做什麼，中介軟體無法直接顯示，

cues.en: because it's happening up on the OpenAI servers and not in our local process here.
cues.zh: 因為搜尋發生在 OpenAI 伺服器，而不是本機行程。

cues.en: So what we are going to be able to go into is we can go in and look at the response items that comes back
cues.zh: 不過我們能查看回傳的 ResponseItems，

cues.en: and go out and find a tool search call and a tool search output.
cues.zh: 找出 ToolSearchCall 與 ToolSearchOutput。

cues.en: So we're going to run it again with what we have. And say hi.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，先說你好。

cues.en: Hi shouldn't really change anything because there was no searches involved because it deemed that my input was not needed to do any tool calls
cues.zh: 這裡不會改變太多，因為模型認為不需要工具，

cues.en: and not even search for any of the tools.
cues.zh: 甚至連搜尋工具都不必用。

cues.en: But what I can do is, if I say, hi, is your profile?
cues.zh: 但如果改成要求顯示個人檔案，

cues.en: Yes, it will now of course call my tool, but I can also see how it did that.
cues.zh: 它就會呼叫工具，而且我們可以觀察過程。

cues.en: So it went in and made a tool search of the part get me, and it come back.
cues.zh: 它先搜尋 GetMe，然後取得結果。

cues.en: So it knew there was something called get me and it could give me back the real tool.
cues.zh: 代表它知道有一個叫 GetMe 的工具，再取回真正的工具定義。

cues.en: And this was on the fly put into the system.
cues.zh: 這個定義是在執行時才加入。

cues.en: So when it did the second call, it had this extra tool on the fly.
cues.zh: 所以第二次 LLM 呼叫，才會動態取得額外工具。

cues.en: And you can see this by this defer loading, meaning we don't load them on the fly.
cues.zh: 這就是 DeferLoading，代表不一開始就載入，

cues.en: We load them only when we need them.
cues.zh: 而是等需要時才載入。

cues.en: And instead we only have some search tools.
cues.zh: 原本先提供的，只有搜尋所需資訊。

cues.en: So essentially what is happening is, whenever we have these 49 tools and we give them to the agent down here,
cues.zh: 基本上，我們雖然把四十九個工具交給下方代理程式，

cues.en: OpenAI will actually go in and say, no, you don't have all these tools.
cues.zh: OpenAI 實際上會先說：你現在沒有全部這些工具，

cues.en: You have the search tool instead.
cues.zh: 你有的是搜尋工具。

cues.en: And whenever we have been called, it will go to that search tool beforehand.
cues.zh: 需要時先透過搜尋工具查詢，

cues.en: And I will give you only the partial result of what we need.
cues.zh: 再只回傳當下需要的部分工具。

cues.en: So it's a little like, for example, having a search in Google, and if you had 100 sites in Google in total,
cues.zh: 有點像 Google 搜尋：假設總共一百個網站，

cues.en: it would show the right 10. This is nice.
cues.zh: 只回傳最相關的十個，這很好。

cues.en: We can save a bunch of tokens compared to what we did before.
cues.zh: 因此比原本節省大量 Token。

cues.en: But there's still that it could just make this search called get me.
cues.zh: 不過，它為什麼能直接搜尋 GetMe？

cues.en: So somehow it knew that name of that specific tool.
cues.zh: 代表它還是知道具體工具名稱。

cues.en: And what we can do is we can go even lower here.
cues.zh: 我們還可以進一步減少這部分。

cues.en: So what we can do is we can go in and say, we want to do a search with one namespace.
cues.zh: 做法是使用單一命名空間的搜尋。

cues.en: And what is namespace?
cues.zh: 什麼是命名空間呢？

cues.en: We will see that in one second, but I will just show you the output first.
cues.zh: 稍後說明，先看結果。

cues.en: If I say hi, we are now only spending 415 tokens.
cues.zh: 只說你好，現在只用 415 個 Token。

cues.en: But if I say show profile,
cues.zh: 但如果要求顯示個人檔案，

cues.en: we now spend more tokens.
cues.zh: 反而會多用一些 Token。

cues.en: And the reason for that is now when we did the search,
cues.zh: 原因在於，這次搜尋時，

cues.en: and we need to find the search, get authenticated users.
cues.zh: 它搜尋的是「取得已登入使用者」之類的需求。

cues.en: So it didn't know upfront about the get me tool.
cues.zh: 事先不知道有 GetMe 工具。

cues.en: But instead, it gave a bigger result about everything that could fit something about GitHub users and stuff.
cues.zh: 因此回傳的範圍比較大，包含各種可能與 GitHub 使用者有關的工具。

cues.en: So it's a more broad search because it couldn't make a very specified search down here where it could give the exact name.
cues.zh: 無法像剛才一樣，直接用精確名稱搜尋。

cues.en: So let's see what's going on and why this happens.
cues.zh: 接著看看發生了什麼，以及原因。

cues.en: And that's the reason why this is a rabbit hole.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼說這個主題能挖得很深。

cues.en: So we're going to run this again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次。

cues.en: And we go down here.
cues.zh: 到下方這裡。

cues.en: Before we just said the search tool was there.
cues.zh: 剛才只加入搜尋工具。

cues.en: And the search tool just being there ends up being a tool that knows all the names of the other tools.
cues.zh: 那種設定會讓模型知道所有其他工具的名稱。

cues.en: And by knowing all the other tools, it will on the fly know it.
cues.zh: 因此它能在需要時，直接知道應該找哪個。

cues.en: It will know all the tool names and descriptions, but it will not know all the definitions, all the input variables and output variables and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 它知道工具名稱與描述，但不知道完整定義、輸入輸出參數等細節。

cues.en: So it will cost more.
cues.zh: 因此仍然需要一些 Token。

cues.en: By doing this, we saw that it went down from the 9,000, but it was still not as much down as this one where we were down to 400 tokens.
cues.zh: 剛才從九千降下來，但還沒有單一命名空間那麼低，後者只有約四百。

cues.en: We saw it was 3,000 tokens.
cues.zh: 原本是三千個 Token。

cues.en: So that was because host tool essentially just gave a kind of instruction
cues.zh: 因為 Hosted Tool 實際上只是提供一種說明，

cues.en: to the system saying, here are the 49 tools name and description.
cues.zh: 把四十九個工具的名稱與描述交給模型。

cues.en: And based on that, it could figure out, oh, it's that specific tool.
cues.zh: 模型就能判斷要找哪個特定工具。

cues.en: So for 3,000 tokens, we had a kind of lookup table that was very, very defined.
cues.zh: 所以用三千個 Token，換來一份很精確的工具查找表。

cues.en: We are giving the host search tool a namespace, meaning we are saying all the tools that are in this search is about GitHub.
cues.zh: 現在替搜尋工具指定命名空間，表示裡面全部都是 GitHub 工具。

cues.en: And we give a description about what GitHub is for reading repositories code and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 再描述 GitHub 工具能讀取儲存庫、程式碼等功能。

cues.en: So we are essentially saying, don't bother with this if something is not about GitHub.
cues.zh: 相當於告訴模型，與 GitHub 無關時，不用理會這個搜尋。

cues.en: Don't use this search tool because it can only give you tools back about GitHub.
cues.zh: 不要使用這個搜尋工具，因為它只能提供 GitHub 相關工具。

cues.en: And when we say, hi, and it only knows that, is this about GitHub or not, we could come down to the 400 tokens.
cues.zh: 只說你好時，模型只需要判斷是否與 GitHub 有關，所以能降到四百個 Token。

cues.en: But now when we give it like this, it's also not knowing the individual names of the tools anymore.
cues.zh: 但這樣也代表，它不再知道每個工具的個別名稱。

cues.en: It just knows, do I need to do a search about the topic GitHub or not?
cues.zh: 只知道是否需要搜尋 GitHub 這個領域。

cues.en: So in this case, we save on every time we don't hit it.
cues.zh: 因此沒使用工具的每次呼叫，都能節省更多。

cues.en: But when we hit it, it's a more broad hit because we need to do a more broad search.
cues.zh: 但需要搜尋時，結果會更廣，因為查詢比較模糊。

cues.en: Up here, we could have it that it could do a pinpoint search because it already knew the tool names.
cues.zh: 上方原本知道工具名稱，所以能精準搜尋。

cues.en: Here, when we set the namespace and description, we don't have that anymore.
cues.zh: 指定命名空間與描述後，就沒有那些個別名稱。

cues.en: We just say all tools in here is about GitHub.
cues.zh: 只知道裡面都是 GitHub 工具。

cues.en: We could have began to put out some highlights over up here saying, yeah, there is a tool called Get Me, for example, and then it would know better
cues.zh: 也可以在描述裡補一些提示，例如有 GetMe 工具，讓模型更清楚，

cues.en: because this is a kind of instruction for that specific tool.
cues.zh: 因為這段描述本身就是給搜尋工具的指示。

cues.en: So when we do it like that, and as we saw,
cues.zh: 用這種方式執行，就像剛才看到的，

cues.en: find the right one here, not that one, that one here.
cues.zh: 先找到正確的結果，不是這個，是這個。

cues.en: So when we say hi, it doesn't even bother with searching because hi has nothing to do with GitHub.
cues.zh: 說你好時，不會搜尋，因為打招呼和 GitHub 無關。

cues.en: And if I said, what is today's sports?
cues.zh: 如果問：「今天有什麼體育消息？」

cues.en: It also doesn't care because it knows that the search tool is about GitHub.
cues.zh: 它也不會使用，因為知道這個搜尋只與 GitHub 有關。

cues.en: But if I say, what is GitHub?
cues.zh: 但如果問：「GitHub 是什麼？」

cues.en: Okay, it will know here, but as long as it's not anything that knows about tools,
cues.zh: 它可能直接知道答案；只要還沒涉及真正工具操作，

cues.en: so the profile, it will begin.
cues.zh: 等問到個人檔案時，才開始搜尋。

cues.en: I must be in the wrong one.
cues.zh: 我可能選錯策略了。

cues.en: Let me quickly do this again.
cues.zh: 快速重新試一次。

cues.en: Or perhaps Luna is not clever enough to know that it's actually a tool called. So there we go.
cues.zh: 或許只是 Luna 不夠聰明，沒有立刻理解要呼叫工具。現在有了。

cues.en: So now it knew, but again, it needed to get a much broader search result back
cues.zh: 現在知道該搜尋，但仍然必須取得更廣的結果，

cues.en: because it's essentially a search recall about more or less all the 49 tools
cues.zh: 幾乎涵蓋四十九個工具中的很大一部分，

cues.en: because we are writing Give Me Something About Users.
cues.zh: 因為我們只說要找使用者相關工具。

cues.en: So it's a mix-up of is with or without a namespace good?
cues.zh: 因此單一命名空間是否更好，要看情境。

cues.en: But there's a fourth example as well where we go into multiple namespaces.
cues.zh: 不過還有第四種範例：多個命名空間。

cues.en: This is where it becomes really interesting because we can actually have this search tool multiple times.
cues.zh: 這就非常有意思，因為可以同時註冊多個搜尋工具。

cues.en: So back to our 49 tools.
cues.zh: 回到原本四十九個工具。

cues.en: And in this version, we're going to get all our tools, the 49, but then we're going to group them.
cues.zh: 這個版本會先取得全部工具，再分組。

cues.en: So we're going to group them based on some string thing.
cues.zh: 這裡先用簡單的字串判斷分組。

cues.en: So if it talks about pull request and the tool name, then we put in a review group.
cues.zh: 如果工具名稱提到 Pull Request，就放進審查相關群組。

cues.en: If it talks about issues, we put it in the label group.
cues.zh: 如果提到 Issue，就放進議題相關群組。

cues.en: If we talk about workflows and actions and so on, so we put in pull requests, GitHub issues.
cues.zh: 另外還有 Workflow 與 Action 等類型，因此分成 Pull Request、GitHub Issue，

cues.en: Oh, yeah, so review and goes into request and so on.
cues.zh: 以及儲存庫與 Action 等群組。

cues.en: So when we just do this, we get four groups, which is essentially taking the 49 tools and group them
cues.zh: 這樣會得到四組，等於把四十九個工具，

cues.en: into multiple underground things.
cues.zh: 拆成不同的子集合。

cues.en: So here we can see the GitHub pull requests have these 12 tools.
cues.zh: 例如 GitHub Pull Request 群組有十二個工具。

cues.en: This has these 11 tools.
cues.zh: 這組有十一個。

cues.en: Repositories have these 25 tools.
cues.zh: Repository 群組有二十五個。

cues.en: And this one with actions only have one tool.
cues.zh: Action 群組只有一個。

cues.en: And now we are registering the hosted tool multiple times, but with the names of those pull requests.
cues.zh: 現在把 Hosted Tool 註冊多次，每次使用不同群組的名稱。

cues.en: So pull request and a description about that.
cues.zh: 例如 Pull Request，以及對應描述。

cues.en: And we are telling which tools that actually are deferring to.
cues.zh: 並指定這個群組負責延遲載入哪些工具。

cues.en: So that group takes care of these tools.
cues.zh: 這組負責這些工具，

cues.en: That group takes care of these tools and so on.
cues.zh: 另一組負責另外那些。

cues.en: So we are essentially given all the tools plus four more tools, meaning four more search tools for each group.
cues.zh: 所以提供的是所有原始工具，再加上四個搜尋工具，每個群組一個。

cues.en: And when we do that and say hi, we get fairly low, but a bit more because we have instead of one search tool,
cues.zh: 這時只說你好，Token 仍很少，但比剛才稍多，因為不再只有一個搜尋工具，

cues.en: we have four search tools.
cues.zh: 而是四個。

cues.en: But if we say show profile,
cues.zh: 如果要求顯示個人檔案，

cues.en: we now use only 5,000 tools.
cues.zh: 這次只需要大約五千個 Token。

cues.en: And that is because this search can be more restrictive depending on.
cues.zh: 因為搜尋範圍可以更精確地限制，

cues.en: So it search in part GitHub repositories and it's only the tools that are in repositories.
cues.zh: 它只搜尋 GitHub Repositories 群組內的工具。

cues.en: Unlucky for us, that was the one that had 25 tools, so we can't go very low, but had it been one of the other groups, it would have been even lower.
cues.zh: 不巧這組剛好有二十五個，無法再降太多；如果是其他群組，就會更低。

cues.en: So with more work, more grouping of these tools, we can say here are the tools for files,
cues.zh: 因此多花一點工夫分組，例如檔案工具一組，

cues.en: here are the tools for this, here are the tools for that, and so on.
cues.zh: 其他功能各自分組，

cues.en: Then we can get it very, very low with just having buckets that might be searched or not based on the namespace name and its description.
cues.zh: 就能依命名空間名稱與描述，決定是否搜尋，將 Token 壓得更低。

cues.en: So for that reason, hosted search tools are kind of incredible when it comes at least to GitHub here because we have these 49 tools and they're very expensive.
cues.zh: 對 GitHub 這種有四十九個複雜工具的情況，Hosted Search Tool 的效果很驚人。

cues.en: Then it's up to you if you feel like it's just a search tool,
cues.zh: 接著就由你決定：只放一個搜尋工具，

cues.en: so it can do pinpoint search, but with a higher cost still, if it's just put them in one namespace
cues.zh: 保留精確搜尋但接受稍高成本；或全部放進單一命名空間，

cues.en: because either people use GitHub or not, or if you want to do this extra work with grouping and stuff, which gives the best balance of everything
cues.zh: 因為使用者不是使用 GitHub，就是完全不用；又或者額外分組，取得比較好的平衡，

cues.en: if you begin to actually do some more work.
cues.zh: 只是需要多做一點設定。

cues.en: But again, it definitely comes down to how many tools you have and how complex they are.
cues.zh: 再次強調，效果取決於工具數量與複雜度。

cues.en: So as we saw with just the search tool on, it was roughly 3,000 tokens compared to 9,000 tokens.
cues.zh: 剛才只加入搜尋工具，就從約九千降到三千 Token。

cues.en: So this was 9,000 tokens, this was 3,000 tokens, then we went down to 300 tokens, then we went a little up to 500 tokens
cues.zh: 也就是原本九千，後來三千，再降低到約三、四百，分組後略提高到五百左右，

cues.en: with less tokens when we actually did the searches.
cues.zh: 但實際搜尋時則比單一群組更省。

cues.en: But again, if you just have three tools, getWeather and stuff, and it's below the raw number of, in this case, the raw number was 9,000,
cues.zh: 如果只有三個像 GetWeather 的簡單工具，基礎定義可能很小；這裡原本有九千，

cues.en: and for that reason, it definitely made sense.
cues.zh: 所以確實很值得使用。

cues.en: If that raw number without any search tools and stuff were like 500, then you would probably not get anything out of any of these tools.
cues.zh: 如果沒有搜尋工具時也只用五百 Token，這些方法可能幫助不大。

cues.en: But now you at least know they are there.
cues.zh: 但現在至少知道有這些功能。

cues.en: Now you know there's a fairly big configuration aspect of this, if need be.
cues.zh: 也知道必要時，有相當多設定可以調整。

cues.en: But if nothing else, if you're already using this GitHub MCP, definitely go in and search the search tool
cues.zh: 如果已經使用 GitHub MCP，至少建議加上搜尋工具，

cues.en: and just cut everything in one third just by adding that one tool.
cues.zh: 只多一個工具，就可能把相關 Token 降到三分之一。

cues.en: But that's everything I have today.
cues.zh: 今天的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
